name: Axis / Cobalt + Ivory
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: ONE ORIGINAL high-end personal portfolio FIRST SCREEN ONLY, desktop website screenshot 1536x1024 landscape, flat edge-to-edge. NO browser/device/mockup frame. NO second section, project cards, portfolio grid, about section, capability map, footer or lower-page content: the ENTIRE image is ONE HERO VIEWPORT.
Identity reference: use the supplied actual source photograph of Zohaib Haider. Preserve his exact recognizable face, hair, moustache/light beard, natural expression, black suit, white shirt and tie. No glasses, no stock man, no new face, no fashion-model substitution. A photographic cutout, crop or duotone treatment is allowed. Never cover his eyes/face with type.
Owner 'Zohaib Haider'; primary role 'Full-stack AI Engineer'. Supporting scope in ONE small line 'Agentic AI · Full-stack products · Payments'. Navigation Work / About / Contact and a clear 'Explore my work ↗' action. A small '2+ years of hands-on engineering' is optional. No invented email, statistics, awards, clients, URLs or job seniority.
User taste: strong editorial personal portfolios with BIG beautifully designed typography, prominent portrait, confident color, clean layered composition, an advanced visual identity, and meaningful negative space. Use the supplied-reference IDEAS without copying a reference's layout. The reference family includes cutout portraits, type overlap, bold color, interesting nav and dimensional details. This must be a NEW composition with a coherent grid.
Typography must be excellent: deliberate mix of condensed and normal-width contemporary sans-serif, optically balanced spacing, intentional line breaks, clear hierarchy. No generic centered white résumé, giant italic luxury serif, illegible cropped words, tech-badge wall, glowing brain/orb, chrome ribbon, workflow diagrams or toy code brackets. Subtle 3D/perspective/parallax cues are welcome, but this output is a STATIC first-page design. No watermark.

Original composition AXIS. Crisp warm ivory #F0EEE8, saturated cobalt #3458D1, nearblack #161A23. A refined Swiss editorial cover with a diagonal spatial axis and a strong human presence.
At top, a restrained thin header: tiny 'ZH.' left, slim Work/About/Contact right. Across the upper quarter, a huge refined condensed sans-serif 'FULL-STACK' at 108px, then a quieter but still large 'AI ENGINEER' at 66px aligned to the far RIGHT beneath it, both ink. A small 'Zohaib Haider' label is integrated into the upper-left baseline, not repeated everywhere.
A beautiful large matte cobalt DIAGONAL PLANE crosses behind the portrait from lower-left to upper-right, cropped by viewport edges, like a single angular sheet. It has shallow physical depth and a soft shadow, no glossy ribbon or glass. The original engineer portrait is a natural black-and-white waist-up cutout positioned just LEFT of center, about32% width, crossing the diagonal plane and the gap between headline rows. Face unobscured and distinct. The blue plane visually connects name/type to image, not an image column.
In the bottom-right clear ivory negative space, a 26px short introduction 'Intelligent products. / Engineered end to end.' with a precise small 'Agentic AI · Full-stack products · Payments' below and a simple dark rounded-rectangle 'Explore my work ↗' button. Lower-left small vertical caption 'ZOHAIB HAIDER / INDEPENDENT ENGINEERING' and one tiny blue square anchor. A subtle slim vertical page-progress index at far-right indicates motion without content overload.
One uninterrupted hero, bold typography and a singular diagonal composition. Professional sophisticated layout, precise proportions, elegant blue/white contrast, ample negative space. No selected-work strip.
